correctness.rationale: All cases are partitioned by spine membership. Trace containment forces the opposite page side whenever one spine vertex is omitted, and forces all page vertices when both are omitted. With both spine vertices selected, one empty page forces all other pages full; otherwise every outsider trace contains one spine codeword and one page-specific codeword, so the traces are pairwise incomparable. The four families are individually sufficient and disjoint, and their exact generating functions sum to the stated polynomial. Exhaustive direct checking of all 349,520 subsets for m=1..8 independently matches every accepted code and every coefficient.

value.rationale: Square-page books are a standard generalized-theta family with arbitrarily many pages concentrated on a common edge, making them a natural structured test family for identifying-set incomparability. The result is not a routine scalar evaluation: it classifies every code, derives the full cardinality polynomial, isolates the exceptional one-empty-page regime, and proves a sharp minimum-code transition from four optima at C4 to two rigid optima for every larger book.
